name: Viking® RVL 30" Black Warming Drawer
shortDescription: The Viking® 30" Black Warming Drawer is a high-performance appliance designed to keep food at the perfect serving temperature. With adjustable temperature settings, convection heating, and a sleek black finish, it offers ample space for warming multiple dishes, making it ideal for any modern kitchen.
metaTitle: Viking® RVL 30" Stainless Steel Warming Drawer

features.text: Can be installed flush or integrated
Heated glass base combined with rear fan provides variable heating modes
Cups Mode warms cups for up to 30 minutes
Plates Mode warms plates for up to 45 minutes
Warm Mode circulates constant low heat for up to 60 minutes to keep cooked foods hot
Rapid Proof Mode provides gentle heat for up to 30 minutes in a warm and draft-free environment, perfect for proofing dough
dehydrate Mode dehydrates and dries foods such as meat, fruits, vegetables and herbs for up to four hours
Slow Cook Mode perfectly cooks seared meat such as roast for up to six hours at a low temperature
Delay Start – automatically starts the warming drawer at a set time and turn off at end of the cycle
Sabbath Mode – keeps drawer in operation for up to 72 hours while deactivating safety shut off and illumination features
Standby Mode – automatically starts after 12 hours of use
Included wire shelf increases loading capacity
